item.title: Houston rodeo cracks down with new dress code after revolt about ‘out of control’ attire
item.summary: The Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo, which just concluded, banned revealing clothing, visible undergarments and gang-affiliated attire following social media backlash.

item.title: Sherrill flexes political muscle in midterm battle between moderate Democrats and progressives
item.summary: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill launches Mission to Deliver PAC, aiming to boost moderate Democrats in key federal and statewide 2026 midterm races.

item.title: Miranda Lambert’s blunt advice that changed everything for Parker McCollum’s career
item.summary: Parker McCollum credits Miranda Lambert with teaching him to say no in the music business, a lesson he says helped him stay grounded and keep creating.

item.title: NTSB flags ‘conflicting information’ in LaGuardia tower, unclear who handled ground-control duties
item.summary: NTSB investigators say a cockpit voice recorder captured the final seconds before the LaGuardia collision as the tower twice ordered the fire truck to stop before the jet landed.

item.title: Fetterman slams Democratic 'mess' as TSA workers miss paychecks during DHS shutdown
item.summary: Sen. John Fetterman broke with Democrats over the government shutdown, warning that TSA agents are suffering without pay as funding talks remain stalled.

item.title: Trump touts ‘significant’ Iran ‘present’ linked to Strait of Hormuz as deal talks heat up
item.summary: President Donald Trump said Iran gave the U.S. a 'significant' oil and gas gift tied to the Strait of Hormuz, saying Iran is ready to make a deal on nuclear weapons.

item.title: Minnesota fire that killed NHL reporter and her three children not believed to be intentional, officials say
item.summary: The fire that killed Minnesota Wild reporter Jessi Pierce, 37, and her three young children does not appear intentional, fire officials say.

item.title: Man accused of timed beatings now charged with murder after woman found dead in river: report
item.summary: Juan Manuel Delgado Jr. faces second-degree murder charges after Krista Joy Hunt's remains were found in the Skagit River amid allegations of abuse.

item.title: Good Samaritans help stop alleged park predator months after repeat offender released: report
item.summary: A homeless NYC parolee allegedly attempted to rape a woman in Central Park just months after reportedly being released on parole for a similar 2022 attack.

item.title: Sid Eudy to be inducted into WWE Hall of Fame
item.summary: Pro wrestling legend Sid Eudy will enter the WWE Hall of Fame this spring, the company announced. He spent many decades in the industry.
